+package database
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"errors"
+	"net"
+	"strings"
+	"sync"
+	"syscall"
+
+	"github.com/gravitational/trace"
+	mssql "github.com/microsoft/go-mssqldb"
+	"github.com/microsoft/go-mssqldb/msdsn"
+	"github.com/sirupsen/logrus"
+

+)
+
+// SQLServerPinger implements the DatabasePinger interface for SQL Server.
+type SQLServerPinger struct{}
+
+// Ping connects to SQL Server and executes a simple query through the database tunnel.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) Ping(ctx context.Context, params PingParams) error {
+	if err := params.CheckAndSetDefaults(defaults.ProtocolSQLServer); err != nil {
+		return trace.Wrap(err)
+	}
+	if params.Port < 1 || params.Port > 65535 {
+		return trace.BadParameter("invalid SQL Server port %d", params.Port)
+	}
+
+	connector := mssql.NewConnectorConfig(msdsn.Config{
+		Host:       params.Host,
+		Port:       uint64(params.Port),
+		User:       params.Username,
+		Database:   params.DatabaseName,
+		Encryption: msdsn.EncryptionDisabled,
+		Protocols:  []string{"tcp"},
+	}, nil)
+	// The driver uses the context for dialing and query execution, but not for
+	// every read during the login handshake. Apply its deadline to the socket.
+	dialer := &sqlServerDialer{ctx: ctx}
+	connector.Dialer = dialer
+	// Closing the socket also interrupts handshake reads when the caller
+	// cancels a context that has no deadline.
+	done := make(chan struct{})
+	go func() {
+		select {
+		case <-ctx.Done():
+			dialer.close()
+		case <-done:
+		}
+	}()
+	defer close(done)
+	defer dialer.close()
+
+	conn, err := connector.Connect(ctx)
+	if err != nil {
+		if ctx.Err() != nil {
+			return trace.Wrap(ctx.Err())
+		}
+		return trace.Wrap(err)
+	}
+	defer func() {
+		if err := conn.Close(); err != nil {
+			logrus.WithError(err).Info("failed to close connection in SQLServerPinger.Ping")
+		}
+	}()
+
+	mssqlConn, ok := conn.(*mssql.Conn)
+	if !ok {
+		return trace.BadParameter("expected *mssql.Conn, got %T", conn)
+	}
+	if err := mssqlConn.Ping(ctx); err != nil {
+		if ctx.Err() != nil {
+			return trace.Wrap(ctx.Err())
+		}
+		return trace.Wrap(err)
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+type sqlServerDialer struct {
+	ctx   context.Context
+	mu    sync.Mutex
+	conns []net.Conn
+}
+
+func (d *sqlServerDialer) DialContext(ctx context.Context, network, addr string) (net.Conn, error) {
+	conn, err := (&net.Dialer{}).DialContext(ctx, network, addr)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	if deadline, ok := d.ctx.Deadline(); ok {
+		if err := conn.SetDeadline(deadline); err != nil {
+			conn.Close()
+			return nil, err
+		}
+	}
+	d.mu.Lock()
+	d.conns = append(d.conns, conn)
+	if d.ctx.Err() != nil {
+		conn.Close()
+	}
+	d.mu.Unlock()
+	return conn, nil
+}
+
+func (d *sqlServerDialer) close() {
+	d.mu.Lock()
+	defer d.mu.Unlock()
+	for _, conn := range d.conns {
+		conn.Close()
+	}
+	d.conns = nil
+}
+
+// IsConnectionRefusedError reports when SQL Server could not be reached.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) IsConnectionRefusedError(err error) bool {
+	if err == nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	if errors.Is(err, syscall.ECONNREFUSED) || errors.Is(err, syscall.EHOSTUNREACH) || errors.Is(err, syscall.ENETUNREACH) {
+		return true
+	}
+	if sqlErr, ok := sqlServerError(err); ok && sqlServerHasNumber(sqlErr, 10061) {
+		return true
+	}
+	message := strings.ToLower(err.Error())
+	return strings.Contains(message, "connection refused") ||
+		strings.Contains(message, "actively refused") ||
+		strings.Contains(message, "no route to host") ||
+		strings.Contains(message, "network is unreachable")
+}
+
+// IsInvalidDatabaseUserError reports a login rejected for an invalid user.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) IsInvalidDatabaseUserError(err error) bool {
+	if err == nil || p.IsInvalidDatabaseNameError(err) {
+		return false
+	}
+	if sqlErr, ok := sqlServerError(err); ok && sqlServerHasNumber(sqlErr, 18456) {
+		return true
+	}
+	return strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(err.Error()), "login failed for user")
+}
+
+// IsInvalidDatabaseNameError reports a database rejected during login.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) IsInvalidDatabaseNameError(err error) bool {
+	if err == nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	if sqlErr, ok := sqlServerError(err); ok && sqlServerHasNumber(sqlErr, 4060, 911) {
+		return true
+	}
+	message := strings.ToLower(err.Error())
+	return strings.Contains(message, "cannot open database") ||
+		(strings.Contains(message, "database ") && strings.Contains(message, "does not exist"))
+}
+
+func sqlServerError(err error) (mssql.Error, bool) {
+	var sqlErr mssql.Error
+	if errors.As(err, &sqlErr) {
+		return sqlErr, true
+	}
+	var sqlErrPtr *mssql.Error
+	if errors.As(err, &sqlErrPtr) && sqlErrPtr != nil {
+		return *sqlErrPtr, true
+	}
+	return mssql.Error{}, false
+}
+
+func sqlServerHasNumber(err mssql.Error, numbers ...int32) bool {
+	for _, number := range numbers {
+		if err.Number == number {
+			return true
+		}
+		for _, nested := range err.All {
+			if nested.Number == number {
+				return true
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return false
+}

+package database
+
+import (

+)
+
+func TestSQLServerPing(t *testing.T) {
+	server, err := libsqlserver.NewTestServer(common.TestServerConfig{
+		AuthClient: setupMockClient(t),
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	go func() {
+		require.NoError(t, server.Serve())
+	}()
+	t.Cleanup(func() { server.Close() })
+
+	port, err := strconv.Atoi(server.Port())
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
+	defer cancel()
+	require.NoError(t, (&SQLServerPinger{}).Ping(ctx, PingParams{
+		Host:         "localhost",
+		Port:         port,
+		Username:     "someuser",
+		DatabaseName: "somedb",
+	}))
+}
+
+func TestSQLServerPingDeadline(t *testing.T) {
+	listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	defer listener.Close()
+	accepted := make(chan net.Conn, 1)
+	go func() {
+		conn, err := listener.Accept()
+		if err == nil {
+			accepted <- conn
+		}
+	}()
+
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 100*time.Millisecond)
+	defer cancel()
+	result := make(chan error, 1)
+	go func() {
+		result <- (&SQLServerPinger{}).Ping(ctx, PingParams{
+			Host:         "127.0.0.1",
+			Port:         listener.Addr().(*net.TCPAddr).Port,
+			Username:     "someuser",
+			DatabaseName: "somedb",
+		})
+	}()
+	select {
+	case conn := <-accepted:
+		defer conn.Close()
+	case <-time.After(2 * time.Second):
+		t.Fatal("SQL Server pinger did not connect")
+	}
+	select {
+	case err := <-result:
+		require.ErrorIs(t, err, context.DeadlineExceeded)
+	case <-time.After(2 * time.Second):
+		t.Fatal("SQL Server pinger did not return after its deadline")
+	}
+}
+
+func TestSQLServerPingCanceled(t *testing.T) {
+	listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	defer listener.Close()
+	accepted := make(chan net.Conn, 1)
+	go func() {
+		conn, err := listener.Accept()
+		if err == nil {
+			accepted <- conn
+		}
+	}()
+
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
+	defer cancel()
+	result := make(chan error, 1)
+	go func() {
+		result <- (&SQLServerPinger{}).Ping(ctx, PingParams{
+			Host:         "127.0.0.1",
+			Port:         listener.Addr().(*net.TCPAddr).Port,
+			Username:     "someuser",
+			DatabaseName: "somedb",
+		})
+	}()
+	select {
+	case conn := <-accepted:
+		defer conn.Close()
+	case <-time.After(2 * time.Second):
+		t.Fatal("SQL Server pinger did not connect")
+	}
+	cancel()
+	select {
+	case err := <-result:
+		require.ErrorIs(t, err, context.Canceled)
+	case <-time.After(2 * time.Second):
+		t.Fatal("SQL Server pinger did not return after cancellation")
+	}
+}
+
+func TestSQLServerPingParams(t *testing.T) {
+	params := PingParams{Host: "localhost", Port: 1433, Username: "user", DatabaseName: "master"}
+	for _, test := range []struct {
+		name   string
+		change func(*PingParams)
+	}{
+		{"missing user", func(p *PingParams) { p.Username = "" }},
+		{"missing database", func(p *PingParams) { p.DatabaseName = "" }},
+		{"missing port", func(p *PingParams) { p.Port = 0 }},
+		{"negative port", func(p *PingParams) { p.Port = -1 }},
+		{"out of range port", func(p *PingParams) { p.Port = 65536 }},
+	} {
+		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			invalid := params
+			test.change(&invalid)
+			require.Error(t, (&SQLServerPinger{}).Ping(context.Background(), invalid))
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestSQLServerErrors(t *testing.T) {
+	p := &SQLServerPinger{}
+	for _, test := range []struct {
+		name              string
+		err               error
+		connectionRefused bool
+		invalidUser       bool
+		invalidDatabase   bool
+	}{
+		{name: "nil"},
+		{name: "other", err: errors.New("other failure")},
+		{name: "refused socket", err: fmt.Errorf("dial: %w", syscall.ECONNREFUSED), connectionRefused: true},
+		{name: "refused agent error", err: mssql.Error{Number: 28353, Message: "dial tcp: connection refused"}, connectionRefused: true},
+		{name: "invalid user", err: fmt.Errorf("login: %w", mssql.Error{Number: 18456}), invalidUser: true},
+		{name: "invalid user pointer", err: &mssql.Error{Number: 18456}, invalidUser: true},
+		{name: "invalid database", err: mssql.Error{Number: 4060}, invalidDatabase: true},
+		{name: "database does not exist", err: mssql.Error{Number: 911}, invalidDatabase: true},
+		{name: "database error followed by login failure", err: mssql.Error{Number: 18456, All: []mssql.Error{{Number: 4060}, {Number: 18456}}}, invalidDatabase: true},
+		{name: "agent relay invalid user", err: mssql.Error{Number: 28353, Message: "Login failed for user 'nobody'."}, invalidUser: true},
+		{name: "agent relay invalid database", err: mssql.Error{Number: 28353, Message: "Cannot open database 'missing' requested by the login. The login failed."}, invalidDatabase: true},
+	} {
+		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			require.Equal(t, test.connectionRefused, p.IsConnectionRefusedError(test.err))
+			require.Equal(t, test.invalidUser, p.IsInvalidDatabaseUserError(test.err))
+			require.Equal(t, test.invalidDatabase, p.IsInvalidDatabaseNameError(test.err))
+		})
+	}
+}
